target.title: fix(ci): restore extension baseline checks
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Several unrelated open PRs started failing shared CI lanes after the latest mainline extension changes:

- `check-prod-types` fails in `extensions/qa-lab/web/src/app.ts` because the web app imports `../../model-selection.js`, which resolves outside `src/`; the actual module is `../../src/model-selection.js`.
- `check-lint` fails full `oxfmt --check` on `extensions/codex/src/app-server/usage.test.ts` due import ordering.
- `check-dependencies` fails the Knip unused-export step for plugin provider surfaces that are consumed through manifests, plugin runtime registrars, provider contracts, or app-server harness entrypoints rather than direct static imports.

This keeps the fix isolated from feature PRs and models the extension surfaces in `config/knip.config.ts` at file granularity instead of widening the whole bundled plugin workspace.

## Evidence

Exact-head proof for `678b4f95e33520feaaa83b8cbd075986f861f828`:

- `PATH="..." ./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check --threads=1 config/knip.config.ts extensions/qa-lab/web/src/app.ts extensions/codex/src/app-server/usage.test.ts` -> passed
- `PATH="..." ./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check --threads=1` -> passed; full repository format check
- `PATH="..." ./node_modules/.bin/oxlint config/knip.config.ts extensions/qa-lab/web/src/app.ts extensions/codex/src/app-server/usage.test.ts` -> passed
- `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` -> passed
- `PATH="..." node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.core.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core.tsbuildinfo && PATH="..." node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.ui.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/ui.tsbuildinfo && PATH="..." node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.extensions.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/extensions.tsbuildinfo` -> passed
- `PATH="..." node scripts/check-deadcode-unused-files.mjs` -> passed
- `PATH="..." node scripts/check-deadcode-exports.mjs` -> passed with 0 entries

Note: a direct local `pnpm deadcode:dependencies` invocation is blocked by the bundled local Node runtime being `v24.14.0`, while the repo currently requires `>=24.15.0` for pnpm install and CI uses Node `24.18.0`. The failing CI log shows the dependency lane progressed through dependency and unused-file scans and failed specifically in `check-deadcode-exports.mjs`; that exact script passes with this patch.
